ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 49

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 30

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
